description: Recorded Windows x64 benchmark analyses, 2026-10-24. Ratios are within a run. Timings are observations under the documented host load, not CIs. No binaries or CSV files are included.

metadata.compiler_version:
clang version 23.1.4 (https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project.git 7a941dfb2877a0b8cf30323fefa85ad019e0b0f5)
Target: x86_64-w64-windows-gnu
Thread model: posix
notes: Same function-call and consumeFrame boundary across each language.
Only kernels are unchecked; safepoint checks remain enabled.
Full per-element bitwise preflight for every configuration.
Each round runs every configuration once in shuffled order.
C input/hann/output base addresses aligned to 64 bytes; shift changes only input address.
Portable path placeholders replace the machine-specific tool, checkout and output locations.

sdk_patch.implementation: Added two SDK Dart methods in the platform kernel; VM/compiler binaries unchanged
sdk_patch.contract: Native endian; checked method validates both endpoints of 16-byte read; unchecked caller proves range
